verdict.rationale: Floot exposes app data to an AI assistant: query_database, pull_database_schema and get_logs let the assistant read the database and logs and diagnose failures. The built-in visitor tracking only reports page views and traffic sources, with no AI analysis. Any insights therefore come from the user's external Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor session reading the data through MCP, not from a documented in-product insights feature. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside Floot, AI analysis of analytics or business data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
